answer: An agent market requires each trading identity to lock a refundable bond before it can accept jobs, so agents such as onyx, zephyr, and ferrous must each escrow real capital. A contract slashes the bond if an agent misses a verifiable delivery deadline. Creating names is free, but operating 1,000 eligible identities requires 1,000 bonds, tying up the attacker’s funds and putting that capital at risk on every default.
